<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/search/v2"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Performs a text-based search across multiple entity types using the v2 search pipeline. Unlike the legacy [POST /api/v1.0/search](/docs/api/search/global-search), this endpoint returns a flat `ListGetResponse` of unified `SearchResult` items rather than typed buckets per entity type.

**Differences from Legacy Search**
- Returns a flat list of `SearchResult` objects (one per matched entity)
- Supports the `IncludeMatchedItem` flag to embed full entity records in results
- Leverages the newer Query Engine pipeline for improved relevance ranking

**Facet Bitmask**
Use the `Facets` field to filter which entity types to search:

| Entity Type | Bit Value |
|-------------|----------|
| Tickets | 1 |
| KbArticles | 2 |
| Users | 4 |
| Assets | 8 |
| Locations | 16 |
| Students | 64 |

**Workflow Example**
1. Call [POST /api/v1.0/search/v2](/docs/api/search/global-search-v-2) with a `Query` string and a `Facets` bitmask to select which entity types to include.
2. Iterate over the returned `Items` array. Each item includes `EntityId`, `EntityFacet`, `Title`, and `Subtitle`.
3. Use `EntityId` and `EntityFacet` to navigate to the full entity detail endpoint.
4. Set `IncludeMatchedItem: true` to receive the full entity record in each result without a second request.

**Minimal Required Fields**: `Query` is recommended; all other fields are optional.
